（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 5310/11 Date 26.1.1934 311）
Date April 26, 1934.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Activities of Workers' Union.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by W Kounen 58.

Six members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union called at the Shanghai Labourers'
Club, 545 Kiukiang Road, at 7 p.m. April 26, when they
requested Chu Hsueh-fan, committee member of the General
Labour Union, for assistance in the matter of opposition
to the Regulations Governing the Conduct of Workers issued
by the Shanghai Power Company. Chu Hsueh-fan informed
them that the matter had been taken up and was being
considered by the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of
Social Affairs.

Enquiries show that the following is a complete
list of committee members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union with correct names in Chinese :-

Executive Committee :
Chang Pao-tai (張宝泰)
Tsiang Tseng-ming (蔣正明)
Moh Ah-keu (莫阿狗)
Yih Yu-keng (葉有根)
Chen Pao-ah (陈保安)
Chu Ah-zai (朱阿才)
Chu Ah-zien (朱阿泉) (who is concurrently
the Chief of the General Affairs Department).

Supervisory Committee :
Hu Foh-ping (胡發銀)
Chiang Keng-loong (蔣根龙)
Yang Ching-chien (楊金銓)

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

制作人：D. S. Pitts 转呈人：W Kounen 58。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 53/0 Date April 23 / 1934.）
Date. April 23rd 1934.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - meeting of workers' union.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by Whouman DSP

Fourteen members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union held a meeting in their
office, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City, between 3.30 p.m. and
5.30 p.m. April 21. Chu Ah-zien (朱阿泉), Chief of the
General Affairs Department, presided. The following
resolutions were adopted by the gathering :-

1. That the unemployed members of the Union be assigned
the task of collecting membership fees in arrears from
the workers.

2. That should member workers refuse to pay their membership
fees, they be adequately punished with a view to
preventing a repetition of such refusals.

3. That representations be made to the local Kuomintang
and the Bureau of Social Affairs for assistance in the
matter of opposition to the Regulations Governing
the Conduct of Workers.

4. That Chu Hsueh-fan be asked to approach Tu Yueh-sung
for help in the same matter.

5. That the expenses of the Union be cut down in order to
meet the fixed expenditure of the Union of $100.00
per month.

The attendance of the meeting comprised the following :-

Chang Pao-tai (張宝泰), committee member.

日期：1934年4月23日。

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工会会议。

制作人：D. S. Pitts 转呈人：Whouman DSP

第四区水电工会十四名成员于4月21日下午3时30分至5时30分，在位于市区的福州路117号该会办公室举行会议。总务部主任朱阿泉 (Chu Ah-zien) 主持。会议通过以下决议：

1. 指派工会失业会员负责向工人催收欠缴的会费。

2. 若会员工人拒绝缴纳会费，应予以适当惩罚，以防此类拒缴行为再次发生。

3. 就反对《工人行为守则》一事，向当地国民党及社会局提出交涉，寻求协助。

4. 请朱学范就同一事项接触杜月笙以求帮助。

5. 削减工会开支，以符合工会每月100.00美元的固定支出限额。

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Workers' Union holds meeting

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by Whouncan

Five members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union and Chu Hsueh-fan (朱学范),
committee member of the General Labour Union, held a
meeting in the Shanghai Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang
Road, between 6 p.m. and 7 p.m. April 16. The
following decisions were reached at the meeting :-

1. That the foremen of various departments of the two
power stations of the Shanghai Power Company be
instructed to collect from the workers the loan of
$3.00 each granted by the General Labour Union with
the help of Tu Yueh-sung during the strike of 1933.

2. That Chu Hsueh-fan be requested to approach Tu Yueh-
sung for assistance in the matter of opposition to the
Regulations Governing the Conduct of Workers.

In connection with Resolution 1, it will be
recalled that the refunding of the money in question
was insisted upon by the Union after the conclusion of
the labour dispute in 1933. However, up to the present,
the majority of these workers have ignored the Union's
notice to refund the money.

The members of the Union who attended the meeting
were :

Chang Pao-tai (張宝泰), committee member.
Chu Ah-zai (朱阿才), -do-
Chu Ah-zien (朱阿泉), Chief of General Affairs Department.
Pan Keng-ling (潘根林), ex-committee member.
Hsu Hung-sung (徐鴻生), -do-

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工会举行会议

制作人：D. S. Pitts 转呈人：Whouncan

第四区水电工会五名成员及总工会委员朱学范 (Chu Hsueh-fan) 于4月16日晚6时至7时，在九江路545号上海劳工俱乐部举行会议。会议达成以下决定：

1. 指示上海电力公司两家电厂各部门领班，向工人收回由总工会在杜月笙帮助下于1933年罢工期间发放的每人3.00美元贷款。

2. 请朱学范就反对《工人行为守则》一事接触杜月笙，寻求协助。

关于决议1，需回顾的是，在1933年劳资纠纷结束后，工会曾坚持要求退还上述款项。然而，截至目前，大多数工人无视工会的退款通知。

张宝泰 (Chang Pao-tai)，委员。
朱阿才 (Chu Ah-zai)，同上
朱阿泉 (Chu Ah-zien)，总务部主任。
潘根林 (Pan Keng-ling)，前委员。
徐鸿生 (Hsu Hung-sung)，同上

Ten committee members of the 4th District Water
& Electricity Workers' Union held a meeting in their office,
117 Foh Yeu Road, City, between 3.20 p.m. and 5.30 p.m.
April 14. Chang Pao-tai (張寶泰), one of the number,
presided. The following decisions were reached :-
1. That further efforts be made to urge the local Kuomintang
and the Bureau of Social Affairs as well as Tu Yueh-sung,
Ling Kong-hou and Yu Yah-ching to approach the
management of the Shanghai Power Company for the
cancellation of the Regulations Governing the Conduct
of Workers.
2. That in view of the fact that the decision of the
Shanghai Power Company to deduct certain sums from the
wages of the workers with effect from July, 1934, for
the repayment of the loan of one month's pay granted
at the close of the strike of 1933, has made the
workers despise the prestige of the Union, the union
representatives in various departments of the two
Power Stations be instructed to earnestly advise the
workers to continue supporting the Union.
3. That the foremen of various departments be instructed
to collect $0.10 from each of their respective
subordinates as a special subscription to the Union
which will be employed to form a compassionate grant
fund. Sums from this fund will be allotted to
families of deceased workers.
4. That the monthly expenses of the Union be limited to
$100.00.

第四区水电工会十名委员于4月14日下午3时20分至5时30分，在位于市区的福州路117号该会办公室举行会议。委员之一张宝泰 (Chang Pao-tai) 主持。达成以下决定：

Date April 6 1931

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Agitation of Workers' Union against New Regulations Governing the Conduct of Workers.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by Whounean ASD

At 10 a.m. April 5, Hsu Hung-sung (徐鴻生), Pan Kung-ling (潘根林) and Yang Shao-keng (楊紹根), unemployed, and ex-committee members of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union, in company with Chu Hsueh-fan (朱學範), committee member of the General Labour Union, called at the local Kuomintang Headquarters, Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi and appealed for assistance in the matter of opposition to the Regulations issued by the Shanghai Power Company governing the Conduct of Workers. Loh Ching-dz (陸京士), representing the Tangpu, promised to refer the matter to the Tangpu Committee for the discussion of measures to be adopted against the management of the Company and to cooperate with the Bureau of Social Affairs with the object of conducting negotiations with the public utility concern.

On the afternoon of the same day, Chu Hsueh-fan interviewed Hsu Ya-fu (許也夫), Chief of the 3rd Department of the Bureau of Social Affairs, in the latter's office in the New Civic Centre, in connection with the same matter. The Bureau official explained that it was extremely difficult for the Bureau to carry out any negotiations with the Shanghai Power Company, which, he said, was "under the protection of the influence of the Settlement Imperialists". He expressed the opinion that it would be better for the Union to approach Tu Yueh-sung, Ling Kong-hou or Yu Yah-ching for the necessary assistance. The Bureau, however, promised to conduct investigations into the matter and to see what could be arranged.

（批：File copy sent to DSD HR）

D. S. Pitts

事由（全称）上海电力公司——工会反对关于规范工人行为的新规而进行的煽动活动。

制作人 D. S. Pitts 转呈人 Whounean 助理副总监

4月5日上午10时，失业人员、原第四区水电工会委员徐鴻生、潘根林和楊紹根，会同总工会委员朱學範，前往位于祁齐路（Route Ghisi）附近的凤岭角（Feng Ling Jao）当地国民党党部，就反对上海电力公司颁布的《规范工人行为条例》一事请求援助。代表汤浦（Tangpu）的陸京士承诺，将此事项提交汤浦委员会讨论，以制定针对该公司管理层的应对措施，并与社会局合作，旨在与该公用事业机构进行谈判。

同日下午，朱學範在新市中心的社会局办公室会见了社会局第三科科长許也夫，商谈同一事项。该局官员解释说，社会局很难与上海电力公司进行任何谈判，他称该公司“处于租界帝国主义势力的庇护之下”。他表示，工会最好向杜月笙、凌孔侯或虞洽卿寻求必要的援助。不过，社会局承诺对此事进行调查，并视情况作出安排。

（批：副本已送交副总监 HR）

D. S. Pitts
